quote: I highly recommend Hema Priya as a valuable member of any QA team. During our time working together, she  have consistently demonstrated a strong understanding of testing methodologies, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results. She take ownership of tasks, proactively suggest improvements, and always ensure that the product meets the highest quality…

quote: I had the chance to work with Hema and it was always a good experience. She’s solid when it comes to writing automation scripts and has a strong grip on testing overall. What I personally liked was how dependable she was — tasks were done on time, and if anyone needed help, she was always around. Also, she’s a quick learner, picked up new things easily, and was easy to work with. Glad I got to work with her!

quote: Although I haven’t worked with Hema Priya on the same team, I’ve extensively used the automation framework she developed for dashboard validation, and it’s been a game-changer. The framework is well-structured, scalable, and saved us significant effort in test setup and reporting. She also created clear, easy-to-follow guidance and was generous in explaining concepts in simple terms whenever I had questions. Her combination of technical depth, thoughtful design, and willingness to support other teams speaks highly of her professionalism.
